LESSON: CROCHETING STITCHES

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: PRODUCTION TECHNIQUES Strand Sub strand Specific learning outcomes Suggested lea
Topic 4.1: Crocheting Stitches

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Crocheting Stitches
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How can crocheting reduce the cost of purchasing household articles?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify crocheting stitches in making household articles
2. use crocheting stitches to make a household articles

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Crocheting Stitches

Teach
• Observe Crocheting Stitches in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Crocheting Stitches (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Crocheting Stitches.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Crocheting Stitches.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Crocheting Stitches.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• identify crocheting stitches in making household articles
• use crocheting stitches to make a household articles

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Crocheting Stitches.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Crocheting Stitches: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can crocheting reduce the cost of purchasing household articles?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify crocheting stitches in making household articles
• use crocheting stitches to make a household articles

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
